notes.title: Q1 2021 Update from Dimensions VIP
notes.content:
The Dimensions team is still here and going stronger than ever.

We've again been working hard on client projects, which is how we fund a lot of the Dimensions VIP work, so that's good, but also means it takes longer to get updates out. 

However, we're also growing the team in order to have more capacity and have hired three new employees so far this year, including two new developers and a UI/UX expert. These new employees are already working hard, both on client projects and on Dimensions. 

As such, we have some cool updates for you.

[h3]New Companion App: Dimensions Story Mode[/h3]
As their first goal, our new developers have worked on a completely new app called "Dimensions: Story Mode". 

Dimensions Story Mode is all the stories from the Dimensions universe without the gameplay of Dimensions VIP. If you are playing Dimensions VIP for the stories only, or you are struggling to progress or simply don't have the patience to wait, DSM is your perfect companion.

Dimensions Story Mode has all past, current, and future stories and scenarios included, so although not even close to all stories are done yet, you will get them all once they release, automatically and immediately. Currently, the Dimensions universe includes:

[list]
[*] Four dimensions
[*] Dozens of Girls
[*] 40+ stories
[*] 400+ hand-drawn scene images
[*] 4000+ lines of dialogue
[/list]

Dimensions Story Mode organizes all stories in storylines so you can follow a particular character story or dimension story as you please. Plus, we give you recommendations for previous stories you should read in order to ensure you have the correct context. You can also tag your favorite stories. Oh, and you can download all images from all stories at once, so that loading new stories is much faster!

Finally, you can also search across stories, including all the dialogues, plus filter by tags so you can find and discover that perfect story for you. 

Dimensions Story Mode will be available for sale on Steam this month with a generous launch discount, and you can already add it to your wishlist here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1207820/Dimensions_Story_Mode/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1207820/Dimensions_Story_Mode/[/url]

Note that Dimensions Story Mode does not include poses or character scenes, nor content unlocked by owning NFTs.

[h3]NFT Crypto Collectibles Release[/h3]
Speaking of NFTs, the new Dimensions VIP client now includes the new NFT app where you can unlock new content by having NFT collectibles in your connected Ethereum address. Currently there are two NFT collectibles available, each with a limited series of 50 editions, related to the 2020 celebration of Dia de Muertos of Xoco and Nenetl.

We will be issuing more NFT tokens, including the first edition of all girls, that each will feature exclusive content in Dimensions VIP. Some collectibles feature poses, others feature additional scenarios. 

To set up your NFT address, log in to your Dimensions VIP account on https://dimensions.vip/manage and follow the instructions to connect your ETH address. We currently support Metamask only.

Note that nobody from Dimensions will ever need or request your private keys. DO NOT give your private keys to anyone, ever. Also, the ETH address verification process includes a fee-less signing of a message. This process does NOT involve the blockchain so you do not have to pay any fees to verify that you own an address.

If all of this sounds... cryptic... to you, we suggest reading up on NFTs to determine whether this is something you want to participate in, whether simply for the collectible content or to speculate in the market. 

[h3]New Content[/h3]
To celebrate the release of Dimensions Story Mode, we're also releasing several new stories, including Patreon voted favorite girl Emile Dubois and her background story. There is also a new story from the Aztec dimension and a visit to the replicant factory in Futopia. Finally, there's a new story featuring Kasey Smith, our resident role playing nerd, and her group of LARPers. 

There is also a new girl available to find and recruit by the name of Monique Steffens. She's part of Bambi's college, a good friend of Kasey, and also an avid LARPer. You need to find and recruit her before you can unlock Kasey Smith's LARPer story.

[h3]Dimensions Bite Size[/h3]
When we started building Dimensions VIP we realized that due to the permanent nature of decisions in the game, we couldn't really have branching stories with multiple endings. If we did, we would block you from seeing certain content, and we don't want that. 

However, we have a bunch of stories that lends itself to a branching storyline. So, in order to allow you to explore alternate outcomes from various scenarios, we're experimenting with shorter games that we call Dimensions Bite Size. 

Bite Size stories are completely free stand-alone games that play out in the Dimensions universe but isn't part of the Dimensions canon. The first story is available now and is a concept story featuring Nenetl and Bambi. You can download that Bite Size now, at https://dimensions.vip/bitesize

If Bite Size turns out to be popular, we want to create many more, as they are relatively quick to adapt from existing stories. Let us know what you think and which stories you would like us to explore!

[h3]2021 and the future[/h3]
To wrap up this update, I wanted to tell you a bit about our plans for Dimensions this year and in the future.

First, as you may be aware, we're currently holding back on announcing new dimensions while we are expanding on the existing dimensions and characters. This includes multiple new character stories as well as side stories of the various dimensions. You may have noticed that we already have started on this, with the recently released stories The Priest and Tiffany Abram's story, as well as the new stories described in this update. 

However, we already have written most of the dimension story of the next dimension, and we plan to start production of that soon. There are also multiple main storyline stories that we need to release before that, to set the stage for the next dimensions and fill out the main lore. 

We also want to start improving on Dimensions VIP, the main game of the Dimensions universe. This will take the form of a major rework now that we have more developers and UI artists. This will modernize our code base significantly (we started working on DVIP three years ago!) and allow us to make a better looking and performing game. 

There are also new plans for mini-games and spin-off titles on the drawing board, including simulator type game set in the Futopia dimension. These mini-games will become part of Dimensions VIP but may also result in full stand-alone games, depending on popularity.


So, what are you waiting for? Add Dimensions Story Mode to your wishlists, and then start playing with Dimensions Bite Size! We can't wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Dimensions VIP update 0.4.2
notes.content:
This patch includes a major upgrade of the platform to Unity 2019.4, which include performance upgrades as well as facilitation for easier and faster development.

In addition, there are two new apps on the in-game phone, for NFT crypto collectibles that enable additional content in the game, and a link to our new Dimensions games, Story Mode and Bite Size.

notes.title: Upcoming Features, collectible cards, new stories, and concept gameplay
notes.content:
Hello all Dimensions fans!

We continue to grow the Dimensions game world, with new stories, characters, and gameplay features. With the recent addition of the Futopia dimension, we're moving into a phase of expanding on the origins of the multidimensional reality, getting to know the various girls better, and adding new exciting features.

[h1]Dia de Muertos Celebration[/h1]
First, we're adding multiple new stories, and for the month of November, we celebrate Dia de Muertos with several new stories set in the Aztec dimension. "The Priest" is up first and out already, and explains more about what was going on in the very first story you encounter when starting playing Dimensions. We think you'll be surprised, but maybe you've already guessed parts of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/df875bf50d48c0fc783fe41107474a0750714a38.png[/img]

There are two more stories set in the Aztec dimension coming out in November, including a fertility ritual story and the origins of the Aztec federation. If you ever wanted to learn more about why the Aztecs still rule, how they came to worship life instead of death, and why the world looks so different from ours, you'll want to play along.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/feac0b69290f89cd0ee00808022c5ca323d92b26.png[/img]

[b][i]Note: We're not only releasing new stories for the Aztec dimension, however, but more on that later.[/i][/b]

Further, there will be two new poses available for Nenetl and Xoco. These poses will be time limited and only players that play during the month of November will get them. 

[h1]Collectible Cards[/h1]
Speaking of the new poses, we're also launching an experiment with collectible trading cards. These cards are ERC721 NFT trading cards, which may be a new thing for many players. If you don't know what they are, I highly encourage you to investigate because it's a very, very cool technology. In short, you might think of NFT collectibles as baseball cards, tracked by a blockchain. 

We'll be launching two Dia de Muertos limited edition trading cards on Rarible on November 2, 2020. These cards will be usable in game, but as is our policy, because they are for sale, they will not impact gameplay beyond visuals. There will be ways to show off your collectibles to other players after November, however.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/4d79237b135c97021613ed59a40095dee6973a59.png[/img]

In other words, buying these cards will NOT give you any in-game benefits over other players beyond street cred. 

We don't do pay to win or even pay to play. Ever. 

What you should know, however, is that these cards are collectibles and you can collect, trade, or sell them as you wish, completely independent of the game, on sites such as Rarible or OpenSea. NFT trading cards has seen incredible growth in recent months, with cards and collectibles reaching hundreds of thousands of dollars in second-hand markets.  

[h1]New Gameplay Concepts[/h1]
Speaking of new ways to show off, that's one of our planned new gameplay features, currently in development. 

The show-off event is a weekly event where you get to pit your girls against other players and compete for valuable prices, including gems, special costumes and poses, and perhaps even some of those limited edition NFTs (TBD). 

Before you freak out, you will remain remain anonymous, and the entire event happens automatically if you do not wish to participate actively. You will get benefits and a higher chance to win better prizes by playing the game each week but if you don't, you still have a good chance of getting rewards. 

There will also not be any way to win or get higher prized by paying more money. Nobody wants that. You get better odds at winning by playing the game, doing things that already benefit your game (training girls, earning Dims in game, using the workshop, etc) but not by buying anything, so no, there is no pay to win. 

Parts of the new gameplay feature is that you get to show off your collectibles, however, including the custom poses that come with it. This is not the only use for collectibles but certainly will make you get more attention. 

We'll detail more about the planned Show Off event as we finalize more details. 

Oh, and we have a second gameplay feature we are currently considering. We even made a video, which you can download here:

[url=https://dimensionsvip.blob.core.windows.net/vid/FutopiaTrainerProofOfConcept.mp4]https://dimensionsvip.blob.core.windows.net/vid/FutopiaTrainerProofOfConcept.mp4[/url]

This is a concept video, so we don't even know if it gets added to the game, but it shows you an idea we have.

The game will be a trainer set in the Futopia dimension, in which you can design a replicant girl and through different stages, try to give her as many orgasms as possible before either of you run out of stamina. Each girl is unique and you can play random girls or follow specific challenges. You can even customize the replicant mid-act to change different parameters such as personality, sensitivity, and tightness. 

This gameplay is inspired by a new story set in the Futopia dimension, called "Visiting the Factory" where you get to see and experience how new replicants are made. The story comes out shortly.

[h1]Tell me more, tell me more![/h1]
He does not have a car... Not yet, at least. 

There are more things coming out. For example, following a vote on our Patreon, we'll be expanding on one of the new French Resistance girls' background. Emile will tell you about how she got involved with the French Resistance and how she's using her family to get back and the Nazis. 

We will be adding more items to construct in the workshop, including usable items. There are more poses for girls beyond Xoco and Nenetl too. 

All of these smaller updates and more like them come out regularly so keep playing and you'll get them, for free, as always.

notes.title: Welcome to Futopia - Dimensions VIP v.0.4
notes.content:
A bit delayed due to urgent work for the team at MOBSoft, we're now happy to announce that version 0.4 of Dimensions VIP is available to everyone!

We have previously announced many of the features of 0.4 but to sum up, here is the overview:

[h1]New Dimension: Futopia[/h1]
Inspired by the works of Philip K. Dick, most famous for his books that in turn inspired Blade Runner, Futopia sees you visit a dimension in which there are human like replicants, designed to serve humans in every way possible. And we mean every way.

[h1]Several new girls[/h1]
You'll meet the replicant Pristine, who is leading a group of replicants trying to survive retirement by hunters. In addition, we're adding three more girls from the French Resistance dimension, girls that are part of Michelle's pussy squad.

[h1]Additional Main Story content[/h1]
We also advance the main story of Dimensions beyond the new dimension. There are three new main storyline stories.

[h1]New animation format and custom girl actions[/h1]
We're experimenting with a new animation format and for those of you that have found Rachel Justice, you can now watch her dominating the player in the dungeon...

[h1]Workshop![/h1]
The workshop is finally open! Bambi has taken initiative again and has converted one of the rooms in the brothel to a workshop, where you can make and deconstruct items to earn gems and build those hard to find items to level up your girls. 

In addition to these main updates, we have also updated several things in the UI, including adding a calendar for daily login rewards, so you can check which upcoming rewards you can get for logging in every day.

We hope you enjoy the update, and remember to let us know if you have comments or questions!

notes.title: Dimensions VIP Next Version (0.4) Details
notes.content:
We're still working hard to bring you the next chapter of our saga of Dimensions VIP, and we're getting ready for the release of the next major update.

In the upcoming version, we have several key improvements and content updates for you.

[h1]Futopia Dimension[/h1]

The next story in our journey is the dimension story of Futopia that we have previously teased. Futopia is inspired by the world of Philip K. Dick and the Blade Runner movies. You will encounter and learn about human-like replicants that are built for sex and pleasure, and whose desires to be more human put them at odds with society.

[h1]Custom Girl Actions and New Experimental Animation Format[/h1]

We are also introducing a new feature, currently available in a trial phase for Rachel Justice only. The feature, called custom actions, allow for unique interactions per girl. For Rachel Justice, this includes a custom dungeon session featuring a new animation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/698c5cccc3f89c3992f9cba8056054e62b8f9fa6.png[/img]

The new animation for Rachel is an experiment we're trying out to see how and whether we can make more animations easier and faster. Please let us know what you think once you see it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/326844bd86c26789c1f435fc9631998a719d5c27.png[/img]

Note that the video does have audio, but we're muting the video for this release because nothing else in the game has audio, and we still haven't decided whether to implement this form of animations and any audio, so we don't want to add any volume controls in the game.
This custom actions feature allows us to create a more rich experience for each girl and for the overall story.

[h1]Workshop![/h1]

We're finally ready to release the workshop. The workshop allows you to create and recycle items, some of which are very hard or even impossible to find. You can now get rid of items you no longer need, although the return may be less than you anticipate. 

The workshop uses materials to create new items. You can find materials from quests, from cleaning out a space when creating new rooms, from the store, or from recycling items you no longer need. 

We have great plans for the workshop, which is one of the reasons it has take a long time to get it done. However, rather than wait for all the features to be ready (can you say facility room upgrades?) we have decided to release it now, with the basic functionality for item creation and recycling in place. 

You can also upgrade the workshop to have room to create multiple items at the same time. For the launch of the workshop, we're going to add a special gems offer for the workshop slot upgrade, which will be available through August 2020. 

We're still looking for balancing on the workshop before we announce further upgrades. 

Note that recycling items give you much less materials than you originally used to create the items, so make sure you only recycle things you do not need.

[h1]Three New French Resistance Girls[/h1]

There are three new girls to recruit in this update. These 2- and 3-star girls are found through girl cards only, at least for now, and can be found only after completing the French Resistance dimension story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/1c5f15e41fee031a9d749b9fd9f1396f528fc897.png[/img]

The three new girls are (from left to right) Antoinette, Jacqueline, and Emile. They do not have any additional content for now, but we would like your input on which girl is your favorite so we can start expanding the content for the highest voted girl first. 

[h1]Login Rewards Calendar[/h1]

Another quality of life update is the addition of a calendar that shows the rewards you get each day for logging in to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/a86d479ee0de129945bbe78d2d824742e6cb5e72.png[/img]

The daily login rewards are based on the day of the month and is the same each month. As such, you can see which rewards are upcoming and when to log in next month to get your favorite rewards.

There are other updates too, but most of those exist behind the scenes on the server, and enables us to make more dynamic and flexible stories, girls, and gameplay. 

The 0.4 update is in final testing and polishing now, so expect a release in 1-2 weeks.

notes.title: Last Days of 10,000 Players Giveaway
notes.content:
We're super thrilled and grateful to announce that we have reached 10,000 players for the free brothel management sim Dimensions VIP. 

To celebrate, we give gifts to all players, new and existing, during the month of May. 

[b]However, you need to hurry because there's only a few days left. On Monday June 1, it will be too late to claim your gifts![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627536/10274052cf5ca62752723bfcfe2c231750e6b324.png[/img]

notes.title: Dimensions VIP French Resistance Released!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the next dimension of our saga is now available. 

This new dimension takes you to a dimension in which the Nazis won the second world war and is now dominating Europe. After Kate helps you find the next amulet, you're thrown into the heat of the French resistance movement and have to help the girls fight their oppressors.

In addition to the main story, there are also a number of new updates in the game, including:
[list]
[*] Multiple new stories, scenarios, and poses
[*] New girls, including the main story girls Michelle and Victoria
[*] New game play mode: House Calls!
[*] Numerous bug fixes, optimizations, and quality of life updates
[/list]

You'll also get a brief look at one of the major story characters in the game at the very end of the main story. 

To unlock the new dimension, you need to first unlock Kate and advance her romantic interest in you. After you unlock that dimension, you also get access to House Calls, a new game play feature aimed at those that play on a more frequent basis. 

If you run into problems, don't hesitate to reach out! We've been a bit overwhelmed lately due to the current state of the world, but we're reading and responding to any feedback, good or bad, as quickly as we can. 

Finally, now that this dimension is released, we're going to start producing more content for this dimension, so stay tuned for more updates, including new girls, stories, items, poses, and scenarios.
